query:
INSERT INTO keynote_speakers (
  full_name,
  title,
  affiliation,
  presentation_title,
  presentation_title_ar,
  presentation_abstract,
  bio,
  photo_url,
  display_order,
  is_visible
) VALUES (
  'Ashraf Abdou Tabll',
  'Prof. Dr.',
  'Egypt Center for Research and Regenerative Medicine (ECRRM)',
  'Current Status and Future Prospects of Medical Biotechnology in Egypt: Lessons from Monoclonal and IgY Antibodies',
  'الوضع الحالي والآفاق المستقبلية للتكنولوجيا الحيوية الطبية في مصر: دروس من الأجسام المضادة وحيدة النسيلة وأجسام IgY المضادة',
  'Medical biotechnology is one of the most important areas of medical care in the modern world, owing to the fact that it has led to the development of new technologies in the areas of diagnosis, vaccine development, and therapy. This talk will discuss the current state and future prospects of medical biotechnology in Egypt, focusing on monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and chicken egg yolk immunoglobulins (IgY) as examples.',
  'Professor Ashraf Tabll is a leading figure in medical biotechnology and immunology in Egypt, internationally recognized for his pioneering work on monoclonal antibodies and IgY antibody platforms for diagnostics and immunotherapy. With more than 110 high-impact international publications, his research bridges fundamental science and real-world medical applications. He has held prestigious research appointments in the USA (Yale University, University of Connecticut Health Center) and Germany through DAAD- and STDF-funded fellowships.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/118031311/JmdTRNcwzCEaJjrU.jpeg',
  2,
  1
);
